name: questlog
description: Where each parallel Claude Code session is: plan, step, branch. Reopen the unfinished ones.

questlog.registryPath.markdownDescription: Worktree registry the parent plans are read from. Empty means `workspaces/registry.json` in the Claude config folder (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, else `~/.claude`). No file, no plans.

questlog.useAgentView.markdownDescription: Ask `claude agents --json` which sessions are running. A session waiting on you shows as Needs you, and one whose process has ended shows as unfinished straight away instead of after 6 hours. Off, or when the command fails, the view uses the session files alone.

questlog.agentViewSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to ask `claude agents --json`, in seconds. Each call takes about half a CPU-second, and your VS Code windows share one answer, so a wider gap costs less and shows a waiting session later.

questlog.resumeCommand.markdownDescription: Command copied when you click a plan slice that has no worktree yet. `{slug}` becomes the slice's slug.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Questlog
walkthroughs.description: See where every Claude Code session is, and reopen the unfinished ones. Needs the Questlog mod in Claude Code.

steps.title: See the current step
steps.description: The status bar shows the step Claude is on, for example 2/5.

steps.title: Open the session list
steps.description:
Click the Questlog icon. Sessions are grouped by repo.
[Open Questlog](command:workbench.view.extension.questlog)

media.altText: The Questlog sidebar listing sessions grouped by repo

steps.title: Check a session's steps
steps.description: Click a card to see each step as done, now or to do.

media.altText: An open session card listing five steps, two done and one in progress

steps.title: Pick up where you stopped
steps.description: Unfinished sessions get a play button. Click it to reopen the session in a Claude tab. If its folder isn't open here, it copies the resume command instead.

media.altText: An unfinished session row with the play button that reopens it
